statement: Death Note is a World 3 construction building crafted at the Construction Workbench
Building Death Note requires Orange Salts from the Refinery and Forest Souls from Worship
Death Note can be upgraded to level 50 and each level after the first gives 2% more Multi-Kill
At level 32 (31 additional levels) he gets 62% more Multi-Kill bonus
Each Death Note upgrade level needs more Orange Salt and Forest Souls and more build time depending on total build rate
Death Note menu shows each world and its monsters; page 2 is Yum Yum Desert and page 3 is Frostbite Tundra
He expects more Death Note pages as more worlds are added
Left side shows each monster with total combined kills from all characters and your current point icon for it
Bottom of the menu adds up all monster points for the world
Each world has a different total Multi-Kill per tier
Monster gives 1 point at 25000 kills and 2 points at 100000 kills and so on
Total points equal the Multi-Kill gained per damage tier which is shown in the AFK menu
More Multi-Kill gives more XP and resources from that monster
His Spores monster shows 75% Multi-Kill per tier and total Multi-Kill 1318% in the AFK menu
1318% Multi-Kill means roughly 13 times more XP per hour and drops per hour from that monster
Current damage tier is based on the maximum damage among your characters
His max damage is about 1.08 million
He has 16x on damage tier working toward 17x
Multi-Kill per tier times damage tier: 75% times 16 gives 1200% more Multi-Kill
Arcade shop gives additional 2.59% Multi-Kill per tier
The arcade bonus adds roughly 42% more Multi-Kill in total
World 1 Miscellaneous tab Overkill Stamp gives 10% more Overkill/Multi-Kill for all worlds
Total Multi-Kill per monster comes from Death Note tiers plus Arcade and Overkill Stamp
